title: The cup that cheers but not inebriates,
html_source:
Found in philosopher George Berkeley’s Siris (1744) to describe tar-water, a foul tasting, medieval medicine.
“…of a nature so mild and benign and proportioned to the human constitution as to warm without heating, to cheer but not inebriate.”
